verdict.rationale: TruffleHog's docs mention 'continuously monitoring' sources and 'continuously tracks the status of all key types' (trufflehog-docs-17, trufflehog-gh-8/9), but there is no evidence of an actual scheduler, cron integration, or workflow/job orchestration feature that lets a user configure recurring scans or automation pipelines. The CLI and docs focus on one-off scans, CI/pre-commit hook triggers, and hosted dashboards, not recurring job scheduling.
